_about: Quests. objective.type: defeat (target = monster id, omit for any) | capture | hatch (a pet egg) | reachLevel (count = level) | chooseClass. `requires` lists quests that must be completed first. `question` is asked on accepting; each answer's `egg` decides what hatches from the Pet Egg. `giver` is an NPC id from maps.json.

quests.title: Hope of Meadowbrook
quests.description: Elder Oak gives every new adventurer three gifts: a wooden sword, a novice ring and a pet egg. Hatch your egg from the Bag, then come back to me.

question.text: Before you go, tell me: what do you treasure most?

quests.title: Jelly Trouble
quests.description: Jelly Puffs keep sliming our vegetable patch! Head east to Sunny Meadow and defeat 3 of them.

quests.title: A New Friend
quests.description: Every adventurer needs friends. Take these Seal Stones. Beat a group down to its last monster, weaken that one below 20% HP, then throw a stone with Capture. It may take a few tries!

quests.title: Choose Your Path
quests.description: Reach level 10, then speak to a guild master in town to choose your path: Fighter, Mage or Beast Tamer.

quests.title: Pineapple Harvest
quests.description: Pineapple Sprouts have taken over Pineapple Shore, north of Sunny Meadow. Defeat 5.

quests.title: The Bouncy Menace
quests.description: Something bounces in the dark of Twilight Woods, east of Sunny Meadow. Defeat 3 Bouncy Buns.

quests.title: Swamp Song
quests.description: Frogs croak all night south of Sunny Meadow and nobody can sleep! Quiet 4 Treefrogs in Frog Swamp.

quests.title: Monkey Business
quests.description: Wood Monkeys from the Smiling Forest, north of Pineapple Shore, keep stealing our apples. Defeat 5.

quests.title: Sheep Shearing
quests.description: The Flame Sheep of the Smiling Forest have set the market awnings alight again. Defeat 4, please!

quests.title: Lights in the Valley
quests.description: Strange lights drift through the Valley of Fear, south of Twilight Woods. Defeat 4 Wisps and see what's there.

quests.title: The Rat King
quests.description: The dwarves of Goldburg are cut off! A Rat King has taken over the cavern east of the Valley of Fear. Defeat him.

quests.title: Dragon Hangover
quests.description: A dragon's been drinking at the oasis in Genie Desert, east of town, and scaring off the caravans. Sober him up… with force.

quests.title: Crystal Hearts
quests.description: We need Gem Crawler shells for the forge. Defeat 4 on Crystal Mountain, south of Goldburg.

quests.title: Who's Afraid of the Big Bad Wolf?
quests.description: A Big Bad Wolf prowls the Snow White Forest, east of the Smiling Forest. Be brave, and be careful.

quests.title: Lost Little Lambs
quests.description: Baa! Golden Hamsters keep stuffing their cheeks with the clover my little lambs need. Shoo away 3 of them and my lambs can graze again.

quests.title: Shell Snatchers
quests.description: Click-clack! Those Mud Eagles swoop down and snatch the prettiest shells off my beach. Chase off 3 of them for an old crab, will you?

quests.title: Straw, Sticks and Bricks
quests.description: My brothers built houses of straw and sticks, and now Tree Snakes keep coiling round them! Chase off 5 Tree Snakes so we can finish the house of bricks before the wolf comes.

quests.title: Moonlight Thieves
quests.description: The Shade Puffs are drinking up the moonlight, and without it I fade away. Pop 4 Shade Puffs and let the light come back to Twilight Woods.

quests.title: The Frog Prince
quests.description: A kiss? Goodness, no. What I need is my golden ball back from the pond, and the Water Slugs are guarding it. Defeat 4 Water Slugs and a prince's reward is yours.

quests.title: The Ugly Duckling
quests.description: The Mud Slimes splash mud on my feathers and laugh at me. Would you make them stop? Defeat 4 Mud Slimes. One day I'll be a swan, you'll see!

quests.title: The Lion and the Mouse
quests.description: An Earth Lion once spared my life, so now I look out for him. The Red Bulls keep stampeding through his den! Defeat 3 Red Bulls and we'll both owe you one.

quests.title: Puss in Boots
quests.description: My master the Marquis needs a clear road to his castle, but Black Widows keep spinning webs across it. Clear away 4 Black Widows and I'll tip my hat to you.

quests.title: Stormy Crystals
quests.description: Golden Clouds keep raining on my crystals until they go dull. Chase off 4 Golden Clouds so the mountain can sparkle again.

quests.title: Melting Friends
quests.description: The Fire Bears keep hugging my snowman friends, and you can guess how that ends. Defeat 3 Fire Bears before we all turn into puddles!

quests.title: Stardust's Night Flight
quests.description: I can't fly under the moon while Poison Skeletons haunt Moonglow. Defeat 4 of them and I'll carry your name across the stars.

quests.title: The Golden God's Grunt
quests.description: Slime Cave, west of the Northern Grassland, is full of Golden Slimes. Their master calls himself the Grunt of the Golden God. Defeat him.

quests.title: Lambs In Distress
quests.description: The wolves of Candy Mountain took Mother Sheep's lambs to the Big Bad Wolf's Lair, west of the mountain. Thin out their pack: defeat 6 Earth Wolves.

quests.title: The Wolf Leader
quests.description: The pack still follows its leader. Find the Wolf Leader deep in the lair and bring those lambs home.

quests.title: Fine Woolen Cloth
quests.description: I need wool for a very special dress, the kind a swan would wear. Candy Puffs spin the softest fluff; bring me what 8 of them leave behind.

quests.title: Wishes of an Ugly Duck
quests.description: The little grey duckling of Swan Lake hides from the Water Slugs. Clear 6 of them so it can swim out and meet the swans.

quests.title: Some Love and Happiness
quests.description: The Lotus Sprites won't let me cross the pond to see my prince. Would you shoo away 6 of them? Gently, please.

quests.title: Animal's Home
quests.description: The Wooden Puppets chased every animal off Puppet Hill. Break 8 of them and the animals can come home.

quests.title: The Puppet King
quests.description: The puppets dance for their king at the top of the hill. Cut his strings for good.

quests.title: Mystery of the Fantasy Ore
quests.description: Fantasy Ore Golems roll about Goldburg Lake. Their cores glow like the goddess Shiria's treasure. Defeat 6 and let me study one.

quests.title: Treasures of Goddess Shiria
quests.description: The ore points south, to the Secret Plain. Idreus guards the goddess's treasure there, and can hit for thousands. Bring a strong party.

quests.title: Sleeping Sophia
quests.description: The Dream Phantoms keep Sleepy Town dreaming. Defeat 8 of them, then wake Sophia by beating the Rock Monster that snores in the cave.

quests.title: The Rock Monster
quests.description: Now the monster itself. It's big, it's stone, and it has been asleep for a year. Wake it up the hard way.

quests.title: Ore of Hachoo Island
quests.description: Even bigger golems live on Hachoo Island, south of the Secret Plain. Defeat 10 and the mystery of the ore is solved.

quests.title: The Temple Below
quests.description: Temple Jellies drift up from the sunken Water Temple. Defeat 10 of them and the way down will clear.

quests.title: The Tide Dragon
quests.description: The Tide Dragon sleeps in the deepest hall of the Water Temple. Wake it, and end it.

quests.title: The Silver Demon's Lieutenant
quests.description: The Silver Demon's Lieutenant holds the Mysterious Cave, the only way to this road. Defeat him so travellers can pass.

quests.title: Crystal Widows
quests.description: Crystal Widows spin webs across the cave mouth. Clear 10 of them.

quests.title: At the End of the Road
quests.description: The Emerald Dragon waits at the gate of the Emerald City. Only a hero near level 200 should try.

quests.title: Turn That Frown Upside Down
quests.description: The oldest oak in Smiling Forest has stopped smiling and swats anyone who walks by. Cheer it up... the hard way.

quests.title: Follow the Pretty Light
quests.description: Travellers keep wandering off the road in the Valley of Fear, chasing a giant glowing wisp. Snuff out its tricks.

quests.title: The Missing Moon-Mochi
quests.description: The Moon Rabbit Queen has come down to Moonglow, furious that someone stole her moon-mochi. Calm her before she flattens the town... with force.
